findings.title: Billable count includes archived (soft-deleted) projects
findings.explanation: The query counts every project in the org and doesn't filter on `archived_at IS NULL`. docs/CONVENTIONS.md says archived projects are excluded from every list, count, and bill. `activeProjectNames` in the same file already applies this filter. As written, organizations would be billed per-project for projects they archived, which means overcharging customers. Change the query to `SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM projects WHERE org_id = $1 AND archived_at IS NULL`. Also consider sharing the filter with `activeProjectNames` so the two can't drift apart.

findings.title: No test covering archived projects
findings.explanation: This function drives invoicing, and nothing tests it. Add a test with active and archived projects, and with projects from other orgs. It should assert that only the org's non-archived projects are counted.
